executiveSummary: All FRs and USs comply. Two minor improvements recommended: add a warn log when PRD markdown is absent, and add a lint script to package.json.
minorObservations: When the PRD markdown file is absent, runCreatePrototype silently falls back to feature/it_XXXXXX with no warning to the user.
No lint script defined in package.json; linting only via TypeScript strict mode.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Implementation fully satisfies the PRD. Recommended refactors: (1) add warnFn call when PRD markdown is missing; (2) add a lint script to package.json.

refactorPlan.title: Log warning when PRD markdown is absent
refactorPlan.description: Add else/warn branches in the prdMdPath exists-check block so operators know when the fallback bare branch name is being used.

refactorPlan.title: Add lint script to package.json
refactorPlan.description: Add '"lint": "tsc --noEmit"' to the scripts section for consistent CI tooling.
